decision.rationale: Existing sources directly show drug/modern-machine/extra-content behavior; neither VE nor non-VE is an appropriate unmodified two-drink low-tech no-buff implementation. Reusing Vanilla ingestion and cooking is the narrowest solution.
decision.independent_gap: Historically appropriate non-drug tea and swallowed toasted rice/barley kogashi-yu in one tiny Mod without drug/caffeine buffs or extra modern items.
